source: # Universal Re-usable Pipeline for Wide-Format Time Series Analysis
Generic workflow template for processing and graphing non-standard wide matrix files.

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

process_wide_timeseries <- function(filepath, group_col, exclude_cols) {
  # Read data
  df <- read_csv(filepath)
  
  # Dynamic grouping and sum
  df_grouped <- df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_col))) %>%
    summarize(across(-all_of(exclude_cols), sum, .names = "{col}"), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Tidy Pivoting (Modern Reshaping)
  df_long <- df_grouped %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -all_of(group_col),
      names_to = "Date",
      values_to = "Metric"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%y"))
  
  return(df_long)
}
